summary: Count to 5 and beyond, count a group to say how many, see small groups at a glance, compare, and read and write numbers.
Name and describe basic shapes, put shapes together and apart, and say where things are with position words.
Match and sort things by what they look like, and copy, continue and make up repeating patterns.
Compare and order things by length, weight and size, and explore measuring with tools and everyday objects.
